ASCetic
A compact ASCII / terminal theme for DeepSeek Harness.
ASCII + ascetic: nothing extra, everything drawn in characters.
## Features
- **Terminal look.** Monospace everywhere, square box-drawing chrome, hard drop shadows, Markdown th

at reads like source.
- **19 palettes.** Retro monitors (`phosphor`, `amber`, `ice`, `mono`), `vapor

`, schemes after editor favourites, plus `auto` and `host`.
- **3 densities.** `cozy`, `compact`, `d

ense`: rows, spacing and type tighten together.
- **Status line.** Agent state and turn timer, steps

and tok/s, a context meter, tokens and tool calls; click a segment for its details.
- **ASCII art.*
* Hero scenes from ascii.rest on empty sessions, a framed New Session button, a retro boot intro wit

h your own logo text.
- **Touch layout.** On a phone the status line becomes one thumb-sized row and
menus become bottom sheets.
A session in tokyo-night
terminal chat style on amber, CRT scanlines on
Palette picker with swatches, rose-pine
Boot intro; the logo text is yours to change

| `ASCII` in the status line | Quick menu: palette, density, chat style, hero art, logo text, toggle

status line | The stock menu: Settings, Feedback, account |

for the next art; `random` draws a new one per session |
| Settings → General → ASCetic | Every opti

`random` draws a new one per session |

Tested on DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.3`.
## Thanks to ascii.rest

All the ASCII art in ASCetic comes from **ascii.rest** by bas3line:
the hero scenes, the glinting bl

ock-letter banner, the `chat` piece, and the `mount()` engine that draws
the New Session button and

the boot intro cell by cell. It is a lovely library, and this theme would be a
lot plainer without i

o cell by cell. It is a lovely library, and this theme would be a
lot plainer without it. Thank you!
Palettes are inspired by Gruvbox, Nord, Dracula, Catppuccin, Tokyo Night, Rosé Pine, Everforest, Kan

agawa
and Solarized; colours were adjusted where text needed more contrast.
